description:
**Due to the high level of interest in this property, please submit all enquiries via this website** Ritz Properties are delighted to present to the market this well presented three bedroom, two bathroom detached family home, situated within the highly sought after residential area of Meanwood.

The ground floor accommodation comprises a spacious and bright living room, a further reception room, a fully fitted kitchen and a convenient ground floor W.C. To the first floor, the property offers a primary bedroom with an en suite three piece shower room, two further generously proportioned double bedrooms and a family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a single garage, off-street parking and attractive gardens to both the front and rear.

Ideally located, the property is within easy reach of a wide range of local amenities, including reputable schools such as Manor Wood Primary School and Chapel Allerton Primary School, as well as Sainsbury's Local. The popular areas of Roundhay, Chapel Allerton and Alwoodley are also easily accessible, offering a variety of shops, cafés, restaurants and further amenities.

Rent £1450 PCM / Deposit £1673 / Unfurnished / Available Now / EPC Rating - C / Council Tax Band - D.
